Keeping in touch with the office
Once work begins, you can contact us about staffing and changes in your project’s needs.
Anything else you’d like to know?
Can I contact you before the scope of work is final?

Yes. Start with the construction stage and required trades, and let us know if the worker count or start date is still being considered. We’ll clarify what is known and what needs to be confirmed before matching workers.
What should I prepare before the first conversation?
Have the project location, required trades, estimated worker count and preferred start date ready. Even if some details are undecided, we can explore your needs together.
The start date depends on the trade, number of workers, availability and completion of the engagement arrangements. We’ll discuss your needs and set expectations based on the actual situation.
Do you continue supporting us after work begins?
Yes. Our support continues after placement, with personal contact and help with staffing matters throughout the engagement.
